process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before running, including `gh pr view 221`, `git diff fde86d1e21ebf8afd2560349e289eb656941d31e..HEAD --stat` and `git rev-parse HEAD`. Each exited 1 with: `apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied`. The bubblewrap sandbox could not start on this runner, which blocks nested user namespaces. Without git or gh, the run could not read the PR's diff, files, intent or head SHA.

No reviewers were spawned, so PR #221 was NOT reviewed. This empty record is not a clean review. Reviewer subagents get their diffs only through the same Bash tool (`gh pr diff`, `git diff`), so each one would have hit the same sandbox failure and returned nothing grounded. Re-run once the runner allows the sandbox (CAP_SYS_ADMIN or unprivileged nested userns), or once the workflow disables the Bash sandbox for read-only git/gh commands.
